section.name: Introduction
section.p: The Flexmark library provides functionalities to parse and render Markdown within the Lutece platform.

section.name: Configuration
section.p: To configure the Flexmark library, follow these steps:

itemizedlist.item: Include the library in your project dependencies.
Initialize the FlexmarkService in your application.

section.name: Usage
section.p: To use the Flexmark library, follow these steps:

itemizedlist.item: Call the FlexmarkService to parse Markdown content.
Specify the Markdown text to be parsed.
Set the desired rendering options for the output.

section.p: This plugin delivers an implementation of the IRichTextContentParser interface, used by the Lutece RichTextContentService. The content to parse shall begin with the prefix specified in the injection configuration.
